6.title: Declare Surplus and Transfer - Part of 640 Adelaide Street North - Adelaide Street North / CPR Grade Separation Project

motion_texts.string: That, on the recommendation of the Managing Director, Corporate Services and City Treasurer, Chief Financial Officer, on the advice of the Manager of Realty Services, with respect to the closed portion of road publicly described as 640 Adelaide Street, located on the east side of Adelaide Street north, more specifically shown as Blocks A, B and C, Plan 449(3RD), and Part Block C, Plan 386 (3RD) as in GD24607, and Part Block G, and Part Lots 1, 2 and 3, Plan 386(3RD) as in 711193, City of London, being Part of PIN 082790121 (LT), containing an area of approximately 178 square metres (0.043 acres), the following actions be taken:
a)      the subject property BE DECLARED SURPLUS; and
b)      the subject property BE TRANSFERRED to Canadian Pacific Railway.
